claim: The window shade on this job, WT-1, is a Mecho cordless rollershade.
rationale: Bid sheet A1100 listed WT-1 as a Mecho Rollershade, CORDLESS Manual Shade; current A1100 (Addendum 2 sheet) lists InPro Manual Cordless Window Shade CF200 SoloMount, French Roast 243-57.

claim: Per the finish schedule, plastic laminate PL-2 is not used on this project any more.
rationale: Bid sheet listed PL-2 as Wilsonart Standard HPL Neowalnut 7991-38; Addendum 2 revised the row to NOT USED (revision cloud shown).

claim: The wall-mounted sink in Toddlers 102 gets set at 15 inches to the rim.
rationale: Bid sheet A800 said TODDLERS 102 - 15" TO RIM; Addendum 1 sheet says 18" TO RIM.

claim: The wall-mounted sinks in Flex 109 A/B are set at 30 inches to the rim.
rationale: The FLEX 109 A/B - 30" TO RIM line is new in Addendum 1 (absent from the bid sheet) and appears on the current A800.

claim: On the foundation plumbing plan the 3" PVC pump-out drain piping is called out under Alternate Bid A5.
rationale: Bid sheet P100 labeled this callout ALTERNATE BID A4; Addendum 2 revised it to A5 (cloud, delta 2); leader runs to the pump-out drain piping.

claim: Floor sink FS-1 on the plumbing drain schedule is a 6 by 6 inch unit.
rationale: Current P001 drain schedule gives FS-1 size as 8" x 8" (Zurn Z-1910-KC-2), not 6 x 6. (6" x 6" MIN. is FD-1.)

claim: S-2 on the plumbing fixture schedule is a single-compartment undermount sink.
rationale: S-2 notes read 18 GA, TYPE 304 SS DOUBLE COMPARTMENT UNDERMOUNT SINK, Elkay ELUHAD-311855 30.75" wide, two waste outlets; S-3 is the single.

claim: Floor drain FD-2 is an 8 inch round cast iron Zurn Z-556-Y.
rationale: Current P001 drain schedule row FD-2: C.I. body, C.I. top, 8" DIA., Zurn Z-556-Y.

claim: The sealed concrete floor finish SCONC is a Prosoco Consolideck product.
rationale: A1100 lists SCONC Sealed Concrete with no manufacturer or product. 'prosoco' and 'consolideck' occur in no words file and not in the project manual text (grep over all words/*.json and manual PDF).

claim: On the electrical schedules, the MSB panel schedule shows a total connected load of 157,413 VA.
rationale: 157,413 VA was the bid-set value; Addendum 1 revised the MSB total connected load to 159,873 VA (and demand to 157,579 VA).

claim: Panel A in storage 107A now carries a total connected load of 40,940 VA with 77 amps total demand.
rationale: Addendum 1 values for Panel A (the bid set showed 38,480 VA and 72 A); the addendum sheet is current.

claim: General note 6 on the first-floor power plan has us routing all the electrified door hardware, access control and security cabling back to Utility Room 108.
rationale: The bid-set E200 had that text as note 6, but Addendum 1 removed it; note 6 now reads NOT USED.

claim: On the first-floor demo power plan, the existing busways in the warehouse stay in place, de-energized, and we only remove the disconnects, conduit and wiring serving them.
rationale: Current ED200 (Addendum 2) note 10 says busways remain de-energized; the bid-set note 10 instead had new feeders from the new MSB to the existing busways.

claim: Per the erosion control notes, we have to inspect the erosion controls at least once every 7 days and again within 24 hours of a half-inch rain.
rationale: Note 3 on the rotated (/Rotate 270) erosion control sheet states exactly this.

claim: The structural general notes design the first-floor slab-on-grade for a 60 psf live load including partitions.
rationale: S900 gives 100 psf including partitions for floors at grade, not 60.

claim: The furnace schedule has F-9 in Threes 105 as a Trane S9X1 moving 1,800 CFM.
rationale: F-9 is 1500 nominal CFM (3/4 HP, 60/58.2 MBH); 1800 CFM is F-6, F-7, F-10.

claim: The electrical legend mounts manual pull stations at 48 inches AFF and wall strobes at 80 inches AFF.
rationale: Both heights are in the current E000 legend (unchanged from bid set; Addendum 1 edited other symbols).
